question_template: How many complaints are pending in {department} or {ward} or department wise?
retrieval_text: how many complaints are pending department wise ward wise department pending counts total unresolved
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name, d.department_name_mar, COUNT(*) AS pending
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name, d.department_name_mar
ORDER BY pending DESC;

question_template: Show {status} complaints for {department} in {ward}.
retrieval_text: show completed pending resolved escalated open closed registered assigned complaints for department in ward bibwewadi kothrud hadapsar aundh ward wise department status specific count breakdown filter
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name, w.ward_name, s.status_name, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
  AND (:status_id IS NULL OR c.status_id = :status_id)
GROUP BY d.department_name, w.ward_name, s.status_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

question_template: What percentage of total complaints are currently pending in {department} or {ward} or city?
retrieval_text: what percentage of total complaints are currently pending backlog ratio total vs open ratio
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS pending_pct
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id);

question_template: Which top {limit} officers are performing best or worst in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: which top officers are performing best or worst overall resolution rate workload officer ranking list
sql_template:
SELECT u.full_name, u.designation, d.department_name, w.ward_name,
       COUNT(c.id) AS total_assigned,
       COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(c.id), 0), 1) AS resolution_pct
FROM user_master u
JOIN complaint c ON COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id) = u.id
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = u.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR u.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, u.designation, d.department_name, w.ward_name
HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 5
ORDER BY resolution_pct DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Which top {limit} officers have the most SLA breaches in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: which officers have the most sla breaches highest delay worst compliance officer list
sql_template:
SELECT u.full_name, u.designation, d.department_name,
       COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.sla_status = 'BREACHED' OR c.sla_deadline < now()) AS breached_count
FROM user_master u
JOIN complaint c ON COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id) = u.id
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = u.department_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR u.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, u.designation, d.department_name
ORDER BY breached_count DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Which officers in {department} or {ward} have not resolved a single complaint in the last {min_age_days} days?
retrieval_text: which officers have not resolved a single complaint in the last days inactive zero resolution audit list
sql_template:
SELECT u.full_name, u.designation, d.department_name,
       COUNT(c.id) AS assigned_open_complaints
FROM user_master u
JOIN complaint c ON COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id) = u.id
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = u.department_id
WHERE u.is_active = true
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR u.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, u.designation, d.department_name
HAVING COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at >= now() - (:min_age_days || ' days')::interval) = 0
ORDER BY assigned_open_complaints DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: What is the overall SLA compliance rate in {department} or {ward} or citywide?
retrieval_text: what is the overall sla compliance rate citywide percentage within deadline performance
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at <= c.sla_deadline) AS within_sla,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_resolved,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at <= c.sla_deadline)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS sla_compliance_pct
FROM complaint c
WHERE c.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id);

question_template: How many complaints have breached SLA right now in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: how many complaints have breached sla right now by department worst department delays
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS breached_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (c.sla_status = 'BREACHED' OR c.sla_deadline < now())
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY d.department_name
ORDER BY breached_count DESC;

question_template: Show top {limit} complaints reaching {sla_threshold_pct}% of SLA time in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: show complaints reaching of sla time critical list warning near breach deadline soon
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, c.sla_deadline,
       ROUND(100.0 * EXTRACT(epoch FROM (now() - c.created_at))
             / NULLIF(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (c.sla_deadline - c.created_at)), 0)) AS sla_consumed_pct
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND c.sla_deadline > now()
  AND (now() - c.created_at) >= (:sla_threshold_pct / 100.0) * (c.sla_deadline - c.created_at)
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
ORDER BY sla_consumed_pct DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Which ward in {zone} has the worst or best SLA compliance?
retrieval_text: which ward has worst best sla compliance ranking ward wise percentage meeting deadline zone
sql_template:
SELECT w.ward_name,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at <= c.sla_deadline) AS within_sla,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_resolved,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at <= c.sla_deadline)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS compliance_pct
FROM complaint c
JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE w.ward_number IS NOT NULL AND c.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL
  AND (:zone_id IS NULL OR c.zone_id = :zone_id)
GROUP BY w.id, w.ward_name
ORDER BY compliance_pct ASC;

question_template: How many complaints got escalated in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: how many complaints got escalated department level wise total escalation counts level 1 level 2 commissioner level
sql_template:
SELECT eh.to_level, COUNT(*) AS escalation_count
FROM escalation_history eh
JOIN complaint c ON c.id = eh.complaint_id
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY eh.to_level
ORDER BY escalation_count DESC;

question_template: Which top {limit} complaints have been escalated {min_escalations} times or more in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: which complaints have been escalated twice or more multiple times escalated commissioner level list
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, c.escalation_level, COUNT(eh.id) AS times_escalated
FROM complaint c
JOIN escalation_history eh ON eh.complaint_id = c.id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY c.id, c.complaint_number, c.title, c.escalation_level
HAVING COUNT(eh.id) >= :min_escalations
ORDER BY times_escalated DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show top {limit} pending escalated complaints in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: how many escalated complaints are still pending open unresolved even after escalation level list
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, c.escalation_level, d.department_name, w.ward_name
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.escalation_level > 0
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
ORDER BY c.escalation_level DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: What are the top {limit} complaint categories in {department} or {ward} or Pune?
retrieval_text: what are the top complaint categories in pune potholes garbage dumping drainage overflow water supply streetlight
sql_template:
SELECT cat.category_name, COUNT(c.id) AS total_complaints
FROM complaint c
JOIN category_master cat ON cat.id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY cat.id, cat.category_name
ORDER BY total_complaints DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Which top {limit} categories are rising fastest in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: which category is rising fastest compared to last month surge growth rate
sql_template:
SELECT cat.category_name,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) AS current_month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month')
                          AND c.created_at < date_trunc('month', now())) AS previous_month
FROM complaint c
JOIN category_master cat ON cat.id = c.category_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY cat.id, cat.category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) > 5
ORDER BY (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) -
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.created_at >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month')
                            AND c.created_at < date_trunc('month', now()))) DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: What is the average resolution time by category in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: what is the average resolution time by category slowest fastest speed turnaround time
sql_template:
SELECT cat.category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_resolved,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (c.resolved_at - c.created_at))/86400)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days
FROM complaint c
JOIN category_master cat ON cat.id = c.category_id
WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY cat.id, cat.category_name
ORDER BY avg_days DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Rank top {limit} wards by pending complaints or resolution rate in {zone}.
retrieval_text: rank all wards by pending complaints or resolution rate best worst ward ranking list
sql_template:
SELECT w.ward_name, w.ward_name_mar,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS resolution_rate
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE w.ward_number IS NOT NULL
  AND (:zone_id IS NULL OR c.zone_id = :zone_id)
GROUP BY w.id, w.ward_name, w.ward_name_mar
ORDER BY resolution_rate DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show zone wise complaint summary breakdown for {zone}.
retrieval_text: show zone wise complaint summary breakdown zones total pending resolved count
sql_template:
SELECT z.zone_name, z.zone_name_mar,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS resolution_rate
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
JOIN zone_master z ON z.id = c.zone_id
WHERE (:zone_id IS NULL OR c.zone_id = :zone_id)
GROUP BY z.id, z.zone_name, z.zone_name_mar
ORDER BY total DESC;

question_template: Compare performance of two wards: {ward_1} vs {ward_2}.
retrieval_text: compare performance of two wards aundh vs kothrud head to head comparison comparison
sql_template:
SELECT w.ward_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS resolution_rate
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.ward_id IN (:ward_1_id, :ward_2_id)

question_template: Show monthly complaint trend for last {limit} months in {ward} or {department} or city.
retrieval_text: show monthly complaint trend received vs resolved last 12 months monthly volume breakdown trend ward department baner registered in last month
sql_template:
SELECT date_trunc('month', c.created_at)::date AS month,
       w.ward_name,
       COUNT(*) AS received,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
GROUP BY 1, w.ward_name
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Which day of the week gets the most complaints in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: which day of the week gets the most complaints daily pattern monday tuesday sunday peak day department ward
sql_template:
SELECT to_char(c.created_at, 'Day') AS day_of_week,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaint c
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY day_of_week, EXTRACT(dow FROM c.created_at)
ORDER BY EXTRACT(dow FROM c.created_at);

question_template: Show top {limit} days with unusual complaint volume spikes in last {min_age_days} days for {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: any unusual spike or recent volume surge in complaints sudden increase last 30 days daily counts department ward
sql_template:
SELECT date_trunc('day', c.created_at)::date AS day,
       COUNT(*) AS daily_count
FROM complaint c
WHERE c.created_at >= now() - (:min_age_days || ' days')::interval
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY daily_count DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show daily complaint activity trend for the last {limit} days in {ward} or {department}.
retrieval_text: show daily complaint activity trend for last days total received pending resolved count daily breakdown date wise complaints today open complaints daily summary ward department
sql_template:
SELECT
    c.created_at::date AS complaint_date,
    w.ward_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
GROUP BY c.created_at::date, w.ward_name
ORDER BY c.created_at::date DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: How many complaints were resolved within {hours} hours in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: how many complaints were resolved citywide average resolution time 48 hours same day resolution stats department ward
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_resolved,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (c.resolved_at - c.created_at))/86400)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at - c.created_at <= (:hours || ' hours')::interval) AS resolved_within_hours,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at::date = c.created_at::date) AS same_day_resolved
FROM complaint c
WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id);

question_template: Average resolution time for {department} or all departments.
retrieval_text: average resolution time department wise which department resolves fastest slowest speed
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_resolved,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (c.resolved_at - c.created_at))/86400)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days
FROM complaint c
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name
ORDER BY total_resolved DESC;

question_template: Breakdown of resolved vs citizen-closed vs invalid complaints in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: breakdown of resolved vs citizen closed vs invalid closed complaints status list department ward
sql_template:
SELECT s.status_name, s.status_code, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
WHERE s.status_code IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY s.id, s.status_name, s.status_code
ORDER BY count DESC;

question_template: What is the average citizen satisfaction rating in {department} or {ward} or overall?
retrieval_text: what is the average citizen satisfaction rating overall feedback score rating
sql_template:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating,
       COUNT(c.rating) AS total_rated_complaints
FROM complaint c
WHERE c.rating IS NOT NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id);

question_template: Which department gets the worst or best citizen feedback ratings in {ward}?
retrieval_text: which department gets the worst or best citizen feedback ratings rating department wise
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name,
       COUNT(c.rating) AS rated_count,
       ROUND(AVG(c.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating
FROM complaint c
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
WHERE c.rating IS NOT NULL
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name
HAVING COUNT(c.rating) >= 10
ORDER BY avg_rating ASC;

question_template: Show top {limit} recent negative feedback comments in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: show recent negative feedback comments with complaint numbers low rating feedback comments list
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.rating, c.feedback_comment, d.department_name, w.ward_name
FROM complaint c
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.rating <= 2 AND c.feedback_comment IS NOT NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show top {limit} complaint hotspots in {ward} or {department} or city.
retrieval_text: show top complaint hotspots in the city geographic clusters location wise counts
sql_template:
SELECT c.landmark, w.ward_name, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.landmark IS NOT NULL AND c.landmark != ''
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY c.landmark, w.ward_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show top {limit} locations with repeat complaints in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: which locations have repeat complaints of the same type multiple complaints same landmark
sql_template:
SELECT c.landmark, cat.category_name, COUNT(*) AS repeat_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN category_master cat ON cat.id = c.category_id
WHERE c.landmark IS NOT NULL AND c.landmark != ''
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY c.landmark, cat.category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY repeat_count DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Give me the full scorecard picture of {department}.
retrieval_text: give me full picture scorecard of water supply health road drainage solid waste department pending resolved sla workload
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.sla_status = 'BREACHED') AS sla_breached,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.escalation_level > 0) AS escalated,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(epoch FROM (c.resolved_at - c.created_at))/86400)
             FILTER (WHERE c.resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
WHERE c.department_id = :department_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name;

question_template: Show active officers and workload in {department}.
retrieval_text: show active officers and workload open assigned complaints in road water supply department
sql_template:
SELECT u.full_name, u.designation,
       COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS open_assigned
FROM user_master u
LEFT JOIN complaint c ON COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id) = u.id
LEFT JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
WHERE u.department_id = :department_id AND u.is_active = true
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, u.designation
ORDER BY open_assigned DESC;

question_template: Show aging bucket breakdown (0-7, 7-30, 30-90, 90+ days) in {department} or {ward} or city.
retrieval_text: show aging bucket breakdown 0-7 7-30 30-90 90+ days distribution pending open complaints age department ward
sql_template:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN now() - c.created_at < interval '7 days'  THEN '0-7 days'
         WHEN now() - c.created_at < interval '30 days' THEN '7-30 days'
         WHEN now() - c.created_at < interval '90 days' THEN '30-90 days'
         ELSE '90+ days' END AS age_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS pending_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

question_template: What are the {limit} oldest open complaints in {department} or {ward} or city?
retrieval_text: what are the oldest open complaints in the city department ward oldest pending complaints list details officer
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, c.created_at,
       EXTRACT(day FROM now() - c.created_at) AS age_days,
       d.department_name, w.ward_name, u.full_name AS assigned_officer, s.status_name
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
LEFT JOIN user_master u ON u.id = COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id)
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show top {limit} complaints pending for more than {min_age_days} days in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: show complaints pending for more than 30 60 90 days older long pending backlog list department ward
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, c.created_at,
       EXTRACT(day FROM now() - c.created_at) AS age_days,
       d.department_name, w.ward_name
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.created_at < now() - (:min_age_days || ' days')::interval
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: Show list of all PMC departments with complaint counts and resolution rates.
retrieval_text: show list of all pmc departments with complaint counts and resolution rates department master list सर्व विभागांची यादी
sql_template:
SELECT d.id AS department_id,
       d.department_name,
       d.department_name_mar,
       COUNT(c.id) AS total_complaints,
       COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending_complaints,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(c.id), 0), 1) AS resolution_rate
FROM department_master d
LEFT JOIN complaint c ON c.department_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name, d.department_name_mar
ORDER BY total_complaints DESC;

question_template: Show channel wise resolution rate, complaint counts, and comparison across all channels in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: show channel wise resolution rate complaint counts comparison across all channels call center web mobile walk in swachhata mobile app web portal best channel serv channel chi tulna सर्व चॅनेलची तुलना
sql_template:
SELECT c.source_channel,
       COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS resolution_rate
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY c.source_channel
ORDER BY total_complaints DESC;

question_template: How many complaints were synced from Swachhata app in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: how many complaints synced from swachhata app mobile app integration count
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS swachhata_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'RESOLVED') AS resolved
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
WHERE c.source_channel ILIKE '%swachhata%'
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id);

question_template: Which department or ward has the highest complaint reopen rate?
retrieval_text: which department has the highest reopen rate reopened complaints percentage unsatisfied citizens
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.is_reopened = true) AS reopened_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.is_reopened = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS reopen_pct
FROM complaint c
JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY d.id, d.department_name
ORDER BY reopen_pct DESC;

question_template: Show top {limit} rejected complaints and rejection reasons in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: how many complaints were rejected and what are the rejection reasons invalid closed complaints
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, s.status_name, d.department_name, w.ward_name
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code = 'CLOSED_INVALID'
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: How many complaints were marked as duplicate in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: how many complaints were marked as duplicate count repeated complaints
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM complaint c
WHERE c.is_duplicate = true
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id);

question_template: Show top {limit} officers overloaded right now in {department} or {ward}.
retrieval_text: which officers are overloaded right now workload score ranking highest pending list
sql_template:
SELECT u.full_name, d.department_name,
       (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code IN ('REGISTERED','ASSIGNED','PENDING')) * 1.5 +
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code = 'PROCESSING') * 1.0 +
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.sla_deadline < now() AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) * 3.0) AS workload_score,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS open_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
JOIN user_master u ON u.id = COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id)
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = u.department_id
WHERE (:department_id IS NULL OR u.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY u.id, u.full_name, d.department_name
ORDER BY workload_score DESC
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: How many complaints are unassigned right now in {department} or {ward}?
retrieval_text: how many complaints are unassigned right now by department unassigned complaints count
sql_template:
SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS unassigned_count
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id AND s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE c.assigned_to_id IS NULL AND c.ward_officer_id IS NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR c.department_id = :department_id)
  AND (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id)
GROUP BY d.department_name
ORDER BY unassigned_count DESC;

question_template: Show top {limit} wards where no L1 officer is mapped for {department}.
retrieval_text: show wards where no l1 officer is mapped for a department coverage gap staffing gap
sql_template:
SELECT w.ward_name, d.department_name
FROM ward_master w
CROSS JOIN department_master d
LEFT JOIN user_master u ON u.ward_id = w.id AND u.department_id = d.id AND u.user_level = 'L1'
WHERE u.id IS NULL
  AND (:department_id IS NULL OR d.id = :department_id)
ORDER BY w.ward_name, d.department_name
LIMIT :limit;

question_template: What is the status of complaint {complaint_number}?
retrieval_text: what is the status of complaint specific complaint number lookup details
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, c.title, c.created_at, s.status_name,
       d.department_name, w.ward_name, u.full_name AS assigned_officer,
       c.sla_status, c.sla_deadline
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
LEFT JOIN department_master d ON d.id = c.department_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
LEFT JOIN user_master u ON u.id = COALESCE(c.assigned_to_id, c.ward_officer_id)
WHERE c.complaint_number ILIKE :complaint_number;

question_template: Show full action history of complaint {complaint_number}.
retrieval_text: show full action history of complaint timeline tracking history escalation transfers
sql_template:
SELECT c.complaint_number, eh.action_taken, eh.from_level, eh.to_level,
       u.full_name AS action_by, eh.created_at AS action_time
FROM complaint c
JOIN escalation_history eh ON eh.complaint_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN user_master u ON u.id = eh.action_by_id
WHERE c.complaint_number ILIKE :complaint_number
ORDER BY eh.created_at ASC;

question_template: Which prabhag has the most complaints in {ward} or city?
retrieval_text: which prabhag has the most complaints in ward prabhag wise complaint breakdown sub ward electoral ward prabhag samiti prabhag number 8
sql_template:
SELECT COALESCE('Prabhag ' || c.prabhag_number::text, 'Prabhag Unassigned') AS prabhag_name,
       w.ward_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_complaints,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status_code NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED_INVALID', 'CLOSED')) AS pending
FROM complaint c
JOIN status_master s ON s.id = c.status_id
LEFT JOIN ward_master w ON w.id = c.ward_id
WHERE (:ward_id IS NULL OR c.ward_id = :ward_id OR w.ward_number = :ward_id)
GROUP BY c.prabhag_number, w.ward_name
ORDER BY total_complaints DESC
LIMIT :limit;
